$comment: matches the csproj property and is here because xunit reads this file when it
is present and ignores the property otherwise — so both are set, and this one
wins if a future xunit drops the property.
It is off because the suite writes one report file from the corpus driver, and
two collections writing it concurrently would produce a report naming fewer
fixtures than actually ran. `ran` is what the 100% required-fixture bar is
computed from (sdks/conformance/required.mjs), so a report that under-reports
would turn a green run into a red gate or, worse, hide a red one.
